company.shortDescription: Echo provides the industry’s first and largest provider of Real-time Engagement Products
company.description:
Echo provides the industry’s first and largest provider of Real-time Engagement Products. It's used by Brands and Media Companies to transform static websites and mobile apps into real-time experiences that significantly boost traffic, increase user engagement, and drive more revenue. 

Echo serves over 1.5 billion page-views per month for customers including AMC Networks, ESPN, Food Network, Travel Channel The Washington Post, USA Network, XO Group and more.
